Tawa Aloo Chaat Roll

For your potato loving kid, here’s a delicious Aloo Chaat roll you can whip up for tiffin today!

10 minPreparation
10 minCooking
2Servings

Ingredients

For 2 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Combine the black salt, ginger paste, chopped onions, sugar and lemon juice mix well.
  2. Coat the potatoes with the mixture and set aside for 10 to 15 minutes.
  3. Heat the oil on a tawa; add the marinated potatoes and stir-fry till golden brown.
  4. Add Kissan Sweet and Spicy Sauce, green chilli and chaat masala and sauté for 2 minutes.
  5. Spread some potato mixture on each chapatti and sprinkle with coriander leaves. Roll up tightly.
